newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Dec 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Dec 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia hopes to join the World Trade Organisation before the end of 1997, says commerce minister.
- A Saudi company wins a 19 million riyal water treatment contract in Cyprus.
- Saudi insurance premiums grew 5.5 percent in 1995, survey.
- Iranians, United Arab Emirates businessmen discuss establishing a new shipping company.
- Saudi Transport minister invites businessmen to boost investments in the kingdom.
